name: Korea Aprokgang / PEFIS historical biometric-technology network

attribution.legal_posture: This is a historical source-attributed research finding with historical status; current sanctions, criminal adjudication, and verified civil identity require separate sources.

organizations: Korea Yalu River Technology Development Association
Pei Fuji Electronic Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
caveats: The reporting is historical; present activity, current account control, and knowing participation by every named foreign entity require newer or source-specific evidence.

Named network and relationships are the central case study of a reputable research report using public corporate records and contemporaneous source material; historical revenue figures and product claims are explicitly caveated by the authors.
Publish as a historical front-company/network profile with source attribution and date context; present activity requires newer evidence.

statements: The 2018 CNS report describes Korea Aprokgang as a DPRK IT company active since the 1990s and specializing in biometric security products and software.
It links the network to a Nigerian-registered company and to Beijing-registered PEFIS through trademark, product, registry, and shareholder evidence.
The report identifies operations or product sales involving China, Nigeria, Russia, Thailand, Japan, and broader Asian and African markets.
limitations: Publish as a historical front-company/network profile with source attribution and date context; do not infer present activity.
Named foreign partners or clients must not be described as knowing participants unless the cited source explicitly says so.
